english.title: Passenger smoke on part of a public service vehicle where passengers were when prohibited by a notice
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a passenger on a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) used for the carriage of passengers at separate fares, at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..),

(A)_[smoked]_
(B)_[carried lit tobacco]_
(C)_[lit a match]_
(D)_[lit a cigarette lighter]_

in or on any part of the vehicle in contravention of a prohibition notice
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 6(1)(d) of the Public Service Vehicles (Conduct of Drivers, Inspectors, Conductors and Passengers) Regulations 1990 and section 25(3) of the Public Passenger Vehicles Act 1981.
